BOSS_SYNC_POWER.title: Synchronize
BOSS_SYNC_POWER.description:
Whenever the Defect generates a Status card, a copy of it is also added to your discard pile.
The first time you draw a Status card each turn, Exhaust it, draw 1 card and gain 1 Energy.
DEVIATION_POWER.title: Biased Cognition
DEVIATION_POWER.description:
Whenever you play a non-Derived Power card, the Defect gains 1 Focus; its Strength and Focus are always equal.
WARNING: Lightning orbs and Hailstorm deal sourceless damage - a summon with "Die for You" will not absorb it for you.
NOT_YET_POWER.title: Not Yet
SLEEVE_TRICK_POWER.title: Sleeve Trick
SLEEVE_TRICK_POWER.description: Each turn, the first time you play a card costing 2 or more, add 3 Shivs to the Silent's hand.
POISON_STRIKE_POWER.title: Poisoned Strike
POISON_STRIKE_POWER.description:
Poison now resolves at the end of your turn, and its damage can be blocked.
Whenever unblocked damage is dealt to an opponent, move 1 Poison from the damage dealer to the target.
WARNING: Poison is damage over time - a summon with "Die for You" will not absorb it for you.
NOT_YET_POWER.description:
Whenever your Block would be lost at the start of your turn, it instead offsets an equal amount of Doom.
When your turn is about to end, if Doom would kill you, your Block and your summons' HP immediately offset Doom until it would no longer kill you.
KNOW_THY_PLACE_POWER.description: Whenever the Regent loses 25 HP in a single turn, he loses 5 Forge, then all players lose 1 Strength for this turn. Up to 3 times per turn.
KNOW_THY_PLACE_POWER.title: Know Thy Place
RESONANCE_POWER.title: Resonance
RESONANCE_POWER.description:
Whenever you generate a card in combat, the Regent's Pillar of Creation triggers as well.
WARNING: The Bomb deals sourceless damage - a summon with "Die for You" will not absorb it for you.
SYNTHESIS_POWER.title: Synthesis
SYNTHESIS_POWER.description:
The Defect gains 3 Artifact at the start of combat.
WARNING: Lightning orbs deal sourceless damage - a summon with "Die for You" will not absorb it for you.
BORROWED_TIME_BOSS_POWER.title: Borrowed Time
BORROWED_TIME_BOSS_POWER.description: Whenever you spend 10 [img]res://images/packed/sprite_fonts/necrobinder_energy_icon.png[/img], your cards cost 1 more [img]res://images/packed/sprite_fonts/necrobinder_energy_icon.png[/img] this turn, and the Necrobinder gains 1 [img]res://images/packed/sprite_fonts/necrobinder_energy_icon.png[/img].
COMET_BOSS_POWER.title: Comet
COMET_BOSS_POWER.description:
Whenever the Regent generates Debris, it is added to your draw pile instead.
Whenever you play Debris, all players gain 10 Block, all Weak and Vulnerable are removed from all players, and all enemies lose 10 HP.
BOSS_SOUL_BOUND_POWER.title: Soulbound
BOSS_SOUL_BOUND_POWER.description: Cards you draw during a turn also count as cards drawn by the Necrobinder (increasing Automation's counter and Death March's damage).
IRONCLAD_RAGE_POWER.title: Inflamed Crowd
IRONCLAD_RAGE_POWER.description:
Whenever the Ironclad plays Anger, a copy of Anger is also added to every player's discard pile.
Whenever a player plays Anger, the Ironclad loses {Loss} Strength this turn.
DOMINATE_WEAK_POWER.title: Dominate
DOMINATE_WEAK_POWER.description: Whenever the Ironclad applies Vulnerable, also apply 1 Weak.
BREW_MOD_POWER.title: Brewing
BREW_MOD_POWER.description:
The Silent keeps her original potion slots and uses potions in combat.
Whenever she would lose HP while she has Block, she loses that much Block instead.
When her Fairy in a Bottle triggers, all debuffs on her are removed.
WARNING: Explosive Ampoule and Serpent Form deal sourceless damage - a summon with "Die for You" will not absorb it for you.
BOSS_COOLANT_POWER.title: Coolant
BOSS_COOLANT_POWER.description:
At the start of combat, add 2 Luminesce to your draw pile and hand.
At the end of your turn, if a Luminesce is still in your hand, none of the Defect's Dark orbs trigger their passive this turn.
BOSS_RAINBOW_POWER.title: Rainbow
BOSS_RAINBOW_POWER.description:
Every 5 orbs the Defect channels, it gains 1 Focus. Its Dark orbs never trigger their passive.
WARNING: Glass orbs deal sourceless damage - a summon with "Die for You" will not absorb it for you.
GO_FOR_THE_EYES_AIM_POWER.title: Go for the Eyes
GO_FOR_THE_EYES_AIM_POWER.description: The Defect will play Go for the Eyes this turn. If you play an Attack card (or an AoE that hits it), that Go for the Eyes also applies 1 Weak.
SHARED_FATE_POWER.title: Shared Fate
SHARED_FATE_POWER.description: The first time the Silent discards a card each turn, discard a card of your choice at the start of your next turn.
SHARED_FATE_DISCARD_POWER.title: Shared Fate
SHARED_FATE_DISCARD_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, choose 1 card in your hand and discard it.
LOCK_ON_POWER.title: Tracking Lock
LOCK_ON_POWER.description:
{Boss} has locked onto you: {Pronoun2} single-target attacks, random attacks and orbs only hit you.
The lock ends when that boss dies.{Extra}
BOSS_PRIMAL_FORCE_POWER.title: Primal Force
BOSS_PRIMAL_FORCE_POWER.description:
Whenever the Ironclad plays Giant Rock, he gains 1 Strength and 3 Plated Armor.
If Giant Rock deals unblocked damage to you, you gain 1 Weak.
BOSS_STELLAR_GATHERING_POWER.title: Stellar Gathering
BOSS_STELLAR_GATHERING_POWER.description:
Whenever the Regent gains Retain, all players gain Retain and Energy next turn.
Warning: Black Hole deals un-sourced damage; summons with "Die For You" will not absorb it.
BOSS_BURNING_PACT_POWER.title: Burning Pact
BOSS_BURNING_PACT_POWER.description: Cards the Ironclad creates through Juggling have Ethereal and Exhaust.
BOSS_RENDING_POWER.title: Reap
BOSS_RENDING_POWER.description: Whenever the Ironclad deals unblocked damage, he heals for that amount.
BOSS_CONQUEROR_POWER.title: Conqueror
BOSS_CONQUEROR_POWER.description:
Whenever the Regent puts a card on top of the draw pile, all players' next Attack deals 50% less damage.
WARNING: Mr. Struggles deals sourceless damage - a summon with "Die for You" will not absorb it for you.
PARALYSIS_POWER.title: Paralysis
PARALYSIS_POWER.description: Your next Attack this turn deals {Reduction}% less damage.
BOSS_OSTY_UNDYING_POWER.title: Undying
BOSS_OSTY_UNDYING_POWER.description: Osty cannot die. It still absorbs unblocked attack damage for the Necrobinder until it is down to 1 HP; after that the Necrobinder takes the damage Osty would have taken instead.
BOSS_WELL_LAID_PLANS_POWER.title: Well-Laid Plans
BOSS_WELL_LAID_PLANS_POWER.description:
The first time the Silent draws a card costing 3 each turn, she retains it.
Her [gold]Murder[/gold] only gains damage from drawing cards while it is retained in her hand.
BOSS_ALL_FOR_ONE_POWER.description:
The Defect's [gold]All for One[/gold] only puts 0-cost [gold]Attacks[/gold] from its [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into its [gold]Hand[/gold], instead of every 0-cost card.
Whenever one of its cards returns from its Discard Pile to its Hand, ALL units gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
BOSS_ALL_FOR_ONE_POWER.title: One for All
BOSS_ORBITAL_BOMBARD_POWER.title: Orbital Bombardment
BOSS_ORBITAL_BOMBARD_POWER.description:
At the start of combat, you gain 1 stack of [gold]Spectrum Shift[/gold].
The Regent is Stunned on turn 1, plays 1 [gold]Bombardment[/gold] on turn 2, and is Stunned again after that.
After 5 turns in which you played a colorless card, the Regent wakes up — and [gold]Bombardment[/gold] turns around and starts hitting the Regent himself.
BOSS_CALL_TO_ARMS_POWER.title: Call to Arms
BOSS_CALL_TO_ARMS_POWER.description:
Whenever the Regent plays a Minion card, if he has fewer than 2 Minions, summon the matching Minion instead.
Whenever the Regent gains Strength from a card, his other allies gain the same amount.
BOSS_LIGHTNING_ROD_POWER.title: Lightning Rod
BOSS_LIGHTNING_ROD_POWER.description: Every time you play 3 cards in a turn, the Defect loses 1 Focus this turn (restored at end of turn).
BOSS_BASH_POWER.title: Bash
BOSS_BASH_POWER.description: Cards in your deck whose name contains "Strike" also increase the Ironclad's Perfected Strike damage. Each time you play a card whose name contains "Strike", the Ironclad's Perfected Strike loses the bonus of one such card.
BOSS_SNAKE_FORM_POWER.title: Serpent Form
BOSS_SNAKE_FORM_POWER.description: The Silent has no hand size limit. Whenever you or the Silent shuffle, shuffle a Snakebite into your own draw pile.
BOSS_SUPPRESSION_POWER.title: Suppression
BOSS_SUPPRESSION_POWER.description: Whenever the Silent plays [gold]Grand Finale[/gold], put a [gold]Void[/gold] on top of every player's draw pile.
BOSS_VOID_CALL_POWER.title: Call of the Void
BOSS_VOID_CALL_POWER.description:
Call of the Void
When the Necrobinder plays [gold]Banshee's Cry[/gold] for the first time, all of your cards gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold] until the Necrobinder dies.
BOSS_VOID_CALL_POWER.hexText: While the Necrobinder lives, all of your cards have [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
BOSS_DEVOUR_LIFE_POWER.description: Whenever the Necrobinder applies a debuff, she gains [gold]4[/gold] Block.
BOSS_DEVOUR_LIFE_POWER.title: Devour Life
BOSS_GUIDE_POWER.title: Guidance
BOSS_GUIDE_POWER.description: Whenever the Regent plays [gold]Decisions, Decisions[/gold], *you* choose which card it repeats.
